summary: Migration to Managed AAP is done by Red Hat: with a migration artifact ready, open a Customer Portal support ticket with the source type (RPM, containerized, OpenShift), the Managed AAP URL or deployment name and the source version; the Ansible SRE team explains how to upload it, imports it and notifies you.
questions: How do I request migration to Managed AAP?
What do I include in a Managed AAP migration ticket?
Who imports the artifact into Managed AAP?
